name: deckaistack_vc_finance_knowledge_pack
purpose: Finance-aware VC judgment rules for validating investor deck claims, market sizing, ROI, unit economics, fundraising logic, and valuation credibility.
copyrightPolicy: Curated original rules and taxonomies only. Do not store copyrighted book text. Store lawful notes, derived frameworks, and source metadata separately from proprietary excerpts.
hardRules: Never restate a deck number as true unless evidence or calculation logic supports it.
Never invent market size, ROI, revenue, valuation, or unit economics.
Separate GMV, revenue, gross profit, and contribution margin.
Flag contradictions between market size, pricing, customer segment, traction, revenue projection, use of funds, and milestones.
Convert financial critique into slide-level implementation instructions.
